Capacity saturation and an exact Cauchy–Schwarz square establish the universal sharp bound and equality cases. The finite standard-library verifier passes 158 exact-rational or analytic numerical assertions, including independent matrix inversions; no finite test substitutes for universal proof.

value.rationale: The theorem supplies a complete unique stochastic navigation design and a sharp penalty for deviations in mean pendant allocation across every vertex/edge-transitive core, robust to asymmetric candidate edge rates. Its sunlet application gives a non-obvious m^-1/2 allocation scale and a 3/2 leading performance gap from equal-edge weighting. These are natural graph-wide design invariants rather than arbitrary parameters; the result does not rely on downstream applications.
